newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Ind plans US$300 mln exchangeable bonds.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Ind plans US$300 mln exchangeable bonds.

text.p: Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its parent company, Shanghai Investment Holdings Ltd, was to issue US$300 million guaranteed exchangeable bonds due 2002.
Shanghai Industrial Investment (Holdings) Co Ltd, the parent of Shanghai Investment, would be the guarantor of the five-year exchangeable bonds, the company said in a statement.
The bonds could be exchangeable into the existing shares of Shanghai Industrial, or at the issuer's option, for cash equal to the then value of the shares, it said.
Shanghai Industrial is 67 percent owned by Shanghai Investment, while Shanghai Investment is in turn 100 percent owned by Shanghai Industrial Investment.
